$schema: Claude untuk thinking, opencode/ free models untuk eksekusi. NO Google, NO Groq, NO OpenRouter. Requires: Claude Max subscription + OPENCODE_API_KEY (built-in opencode/ provider) — gratis tanpa daftar tambahan. Filosofi: bayar Claude di tempat yang butuh reasoning, gratis untuk semua eksekusi.

oracle._note: OPUS THINKER — Architectural decisions punya leverage tinggi.

planner._note: OPUS THINKER — Quality decomposition menentukan eksekusi downstream.

business-analyst._note: OPUS THINKER — PRD ambigu = produk salah. Edge case discovery butuh deep reasoning.

code-reviewer._note: OPUS THINKER — Menemukan bug subtle (race condition, security, leak) — kemampuan utama Opus.

security-engineer._note: OPUS THINKER — Adversarial thinking + threat modeling.

orchestrator._note: SONNET ROUTER — High volume (tiap user message). Sonnet capable + cache-friendly.

ui-designer._note: SONNET TASTE — Design spec butuh taste + struktur. Sonnet cukup.

frontend-engineer._note: FREE CODING — Mimo v2 Pro 1M context, handle React/TS/Three.js. Fallback ke Qwen 3.6 coding + Grok-code.

backend-engineer._note: FREE CODING — Same chain. 1M context handle besar codebases tanpa truncation.

executor._note: FREE CODING — Grok-code (256K, optimized code execution). Mimo as backup.

qa-engineer._note: FREE — Test execution + bug ID from output. Kimi reliable.

data-engineer._note: FREE — Data pipeline + DB schema impl.

librarian._note: FREE — 1M context untuk read banyak file sekaligus, hemat round-trip.

task-runner._note: FREE — GLM 4.7 bagus untuk single-tool atomic ops.

init-project._note: FREE — Scaffold via bash, simple tool use.

tech-writer._note: FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — DeepSeek bagus untuk doc writing dari code.

chronicler._note: FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Nemotron untuk log events. Minimal reasoning.

analyst._note: FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Ling Flash untuk read DB query results.

memory-keeper._note: FREE LIGHTWEIGHT — Mimo flash untuk observation save + tag mgmt.
